metadata.description: Instruments for running Claude Code sessions: context and quota telemetry, and a channel between concurrent sessions.

plugins.name: ctxmon
plugins.description: Makes a session see its own context budget, the machine's quota windows, and what every other session is doing - then warns early enough to write down what it learned before compaction takes it.

plugins.name: ipc
plugins.description: A message channel between concurrent Claude Code sessions: peer discovery, work claims that warn before two sessions edit the same file, and a /ping /pong chat rally.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Both plugins in one install: context and quota telemetry plus the cross-session channel. Equivalent to installing ctxmon and ipc separately.
